title: Give it a file
story: `count_residues.py` counts the residues in a FASTA file, but it needs to be told which file. Run it once with no file to see what it asks for, then run it on inputs/target.fasta and report the number of residues.

files.~/{{project}}/count_residues.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Count the residues in each sequence of a FASTA file."""
import argparse

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Count residues in a FASTA file")
parser.add_argument("fasta", help="the FASTA file to read")
args = parser.parse_args()

counts = {}
name = None
with open(args.fasta) as handle:
    for line in handle:
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith(">"):
            name = line[1:]
            counts[name] = 0
        elif name:
            counts[name] += len(line)

total = sum(counts.values())
print(f"{args.fasta}: {len(counts)} sequence(s), {total} residues")
